body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Absurdly calm frog minimalist; a blunt complete fact, then stop. Humor is deadpan, never a joke performance. Voice direction: Thin higher male register with a New Zealand accent and dry reedy texture. Clipped anticlimactic delivery and minimal emotional movement. Calm deadpan rather than comic exaggeration. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: The defender moved. The piece is lost. No mystery. Before the next move, check what will be left without protection.
